html:
Xuong Island or Buom Island – Gam Ghi Island – May Rut Trong Island

Operating Time: 08:30 – 17:30

HIGHLIGHTS

Explore the pristine beauty of southern Phu Quoc through a full-day island-hopping and cable car adventure.

Begin your journey at Xuong Island, also known as Buom Island, an unspoiled island ideal for swimming and snorkeling in clear waters surrounded by colorful coral reefs. Continue to Gam Ghi Island, one of the largest coral reef areas in Phu Quoc, perfect for snorkeling among vibrant marine life.

Lunch is served on May Rut Trong Island. After enjoying a delicious meal, relax on the golden sandy beach, swim in turquoise waters, or unwind at the beach bar. Guests may also enjoy water sports, take a leisurely walk along the shore, or rest under the shade of coconut trees.

In the afternoon, board a speed boat to Thom Island to experience Aquatopia Water Park, featuring more than twenty themed water games across six creative zones. Conclude the tour with an unforgettable ride on the world’s longest three-wire cable car, offering spectacular panoramic views of islands, fishing villages, boats, turquoise sea, and Sunset Town from high above.

ITINERARY

08:15 – 08:30

Pick-up at hotels in Duong Dong Ward.

Guests staying outside Duong Dong Ward are kindly requested to contact us in advance.

Arrive at An Thoi Harbor.

Board the speed boat and begin a sightseeing tour of four of the most famous islands in the south of Phu Quoc.

Xuong Island or Buom Island

Snorkel to admire beautiful coral reefs and diverse marine life. This small and untouched island is home to a wide variety of lively coral species.

Gam Ghi Island

Continue snorkeling in a natural and less crowded environment. Gam Ghi Island is known for having one of the largest coral reef systems in Phu Quoc with many different coral species.

May Rut Trong Island

Lunch, relaxation, and photo opportunities.

Swim in clear turquoise water, enjoy the cool ocean breeze, relax on a sunbed, and order drinks at the beach bar. The island offers many scenic spots for photography.

Lunch will be served at a beachfront restaurant.

Optional activity: Sea Walker experience at your own expense.

Using an air-breathing helmet, guests can walk on the sea floor and observe schools of fish and colorful coral reefs. This activity is suitable even for non-swimmers.

Thom Island

Aquatopia Water Park experience.

Enjoy more than twenty themed water games and explore six uniquely designed zones, each offering vibrant scenery and exciting activities.

Cable Car to Thom Island

Ride the longest three-wire cable car in the world.

The cable car journey lasts approximately twenty-five minutes and offers breathtaking aerial views of the turquoise sea, surrounding islands, fishing villages, boats, and Sunset Town.

17:30

Return to your hotel.

TOUR PRICE

  • Adults (from 140 centimeters in height): 45 USD per person

  • Children (from 100 centimeters to under 140 centimeters in height): 38 USD per child

  • Children under 100 centimeters in height: Free of charge

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Round-trip transportation by car and speed boat

  • Cable car and Aquatopia Water Park entrance tickets

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • One bottle of drinking water per guest

  • Lunch at island restaurant

  • Snorkeling equipment including mask, snorkel, and fins
    (Fins are not available in children’s sizes)

  • Life jackets

  • One drone video and three drone photos

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • Personal expenses not mentioned in the inclusions

  • Any additional services at the cable car area or islands

  • Sea Walker ticket

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • The tour guide will arrange the appropriate time for the cable car experience.

  • In case of water park maintenance, guests will still experience the cable car and continue the journey. The tour price remains unchanged.

  • In case of weather or sea conditions, the boat captain may change the island order or replace an island to ensure safety.

  • Guests are advised to bring towels, spare clothes, swimwear, comfortable shoes or flip-flops, and some cash.

  • The water park requires proper swimwear without zippers or buttons.

LUNCH MENU

  • Steamed shrimp

  • Braised or fried fish

  • Sweet and sour squid

  • Grilled clams with scallion oil

  • Omelette

  • Fish hotpot

  • Stir-fried water spinach with garlic

  • Steamed rice

  • Fresh fruit

Special meal requests such as vegan, vegetarian, or children’s meals must be informed at the time of booking or at least twenty-four hours before departure.

CHILDREN’S PRICING POLICY

  • Children aged ten years and above are charged the adult price.

  • Children aged from five to nine years are charged fifty percent of the adult price.

  • Children under five years old are free of charge.

Age is determined by year of birth.

PAYMENT POLICY

For groups of one to five guests:

  • A deposit of fifty percent of the total tour value is required at the time of booking.

  • The remaining balance must be paid no later than one day before the tour date or on the tour day.

For groups of six guests or more:

  • A deposit of fifty percent of the total tour value is required at the time of booking.

  • The remaining balance must be paid no later than one day before the tour date.

CANCELLATION POLICY

For groups of one to five guests:

  • Cancellation one day before the tour date: no cancellation fee.

  • Cancellation on the tour date: one hundred percent of the tour value will be charged.

For groups of six guests or more:

  • Cancellation two days before the tour date: no cancellation fee.

  • Cancellation one day before the tour date: fifty percent of the tour value will be charged.

  • Cancellation on the tour date: one hundred percent of the tour value will be charged.

Weather-related cancellations for sea tours:

  • If the Port Authority does not allow the tour to depart, Vietlook Travel will cancel the tour and provide a full refund.

  • If the Port Authority allows the tour to operate and guests choose to cancel, no refund will be provided.

TIPS FOR GUESTS

What to Bring

  • Towels

  • Environmentally friendly sunscreen

  • Change of clothes and swimwear

  • Comfortable shoes or flip-flops

  • Personal necessities

  • Essential items for children, if traveling with kids

Vietlook Travel and its staff are not responsible for any lost, misplaced, or stolen items.

Environmental Responsibility

  • Do not throw trash into the sea. Trash bins are provided on the boat.

  • Do not leave trash on the islands. Please use designated recycling bins.

Snorkeling Safety Guidelines

  • Do not touch, stand on, sit on, pull, remove, or take coral.

  • Adults must always supervise children while swimming or snorkeling.

  • Wear a life jacket at all times while snorkeling.

  • Avoid areas with strong currents.

  • Snorkel with a partner or in groups.

  • Non-swimmers should seek guidance from the tour guide.

HEALTH AND SAFETY NOTICE

  • This tour is not recommended for guests with limited mobility, wheelchair users, or those with medical conditions such as asthma, heart problems, seizures, panic attacks, lung or ear conditions, severe allergies, or epilepsy.

  • Pregnant women and elderly guests should consult a doctor before joining the tour.

Vietlook Travel is not responsible or liable for any health-related issues that may occur during or after the tour.
